description: This file contains a stub implementation for the Rialto Session Server used in testing. It defines a Service class that simulates server responses, manages client connections, and provides methods to send events and disconnect clients, primarily for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: A mock service class inheriting from rialto::ServerManagerModule, used to simulate server responses in tests.

methods.name: RialtoSessionServerStub::start
methods.description: Initializes the stub, creates a client connection, and starts the server processing thread.

methods.name: RialtoSessionServerStub::getClientSocket
methods.description: Returns the socket descriptor for the client connection.

methods.name: RialtoSessionServerStub::sendStateChangedEvent
methods.description: Sends a state changed event to the client.

methods.name: RialtoSessionServerStub::sendAckEvent
methods.description: Sends an acknowledgment event with a ping ID and success status.
